title: She Comes For You
source_seed: The advancing stride + the fierce protector who is a tender mother
caption_hook: She comes for the ones who call. Fierce to what threatens you, Mother to you.

shots.camera: Eye level, front-facing, three-quarter-length framing from the reference portrait. The camera pulls back slowly and steadily so She stays the same size in frame as She advances, with the crown and golden sun disc centered and fully framed.
shots.action: She walks slowly toward the viewer through the calm shallow water, each step firm and weighty, Her stern gaze fixed on the viewer and Her arms swinging naturally at Her sides. As She draws close, Her stern look eases into a faint, tender smile and the vertical third eye lights with a soft silver-blue glow. Her hair settles under natural gravity.
shots.purpose: Real body motion (verified on Kali) carrying one story: the protector arrives, then recognises the viewer as Her own.
